insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Pre-existing disease waiting period of only 12 months (industry-leading low) for senior entrants.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room: 1% of SI/day (SI 1-5L), Rs 6,000/day (SI 7.5-10L), up to Rs 10,000/day (SI 25L)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Hospitalization expenses prorated to room rent eligibility.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH in-patient up to Sum Insured (excluding Yoga & Naturopathy)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs 600 per hosp (SI 1-4L), Rs 1,000 (SI 5-10L), Rs 1,500 (SI 15-25L); double per policy period

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Package A (SI Rs 5-7.5L) or Package B (SI Rs 10L+); once per policy year per insured
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Initial 30-day waiting from first inception. Tests available at network providers.

room_rent_capping: 1% of SI per day (SI 1-5L) to Rs 10,000/day (SI 25L)
copayment_trigger_notes: 30% copay applies to all claims (senior citizen plan).

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Rs 15,000 (SI 1-2L) up to Rs 40,000 (SI 25L) per person per policy period
disease_wise_sub_limits.surgeon_consultant_fees: Up to 25% of SI per hospitalization
disease_wise_sub_limits.anaesthesia_blood_oxygen_ot_pacemaker: Up to 50% of SI per hospitalization
disease_wise_sub_limits.home_care_treatment: 10% of SI or max Rs 50,000 per policy year
disease_wise_sub_limits.post_hospitalization: 7% of hospitalization expenses; max Rs 5,000-10,000 per occurrence

notable_exclusions_summary: Senior-citizen plan with 30% mandatory copay on every claim and sub-limits on cardiac, cancer, renal and orthopedic conditions. PED waiting is short (12 months).
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Star Health network. Toll-free 1800 425 2255. Out-patient consultations settled cashless within annual limits.
